chunks: And his family who had stood by him,

key_terms.فَصِيلَتِهِ: His close kin or family members

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'his family who had stood by him'?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Ma'arij, this phrase emphasizes the moral obligation of providing material and emotional refuge to one's immediate kin, reflecting the pre-Islamic and Islamic emphasis on tribal and familial loyalty. Shia scholarship often interprets this as a foundational social duty that extends to the Ahl al-Bayt, highlighting the family unit as the primary cell of societal stability and spiritual support.
